assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: MS1 spectra were acquired with a resolution of 120,000 in the orbitrap (OT)
Dynamic exclusion was set to 30 seconds
MS2 spectra were recorded with a resolution of 30,000 in OT
Fragmentation was enforced by higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
enrichment: Cross-linked peptides were resuspended in 50 µl 30 % acetonitrile/0.1 % TFA and enriched by peptide size exclusion chromatography/pSEC
Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: Cross-links were displayed with xiNET and XlinkAnalyzer

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using the BS3 crosslinker. While not a traditional 'tpp' (thermal proteome profiling) assay, the 'mod_tpp' modifier is often used as a proxy for structural/interaction proteomics in some routing schemas, but specifically, this is XL-MS. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of dynamic exclusion and precursor selection.

organism: S. scrofa Pol II and human initiation factors TBP, TFIIA, TFIIB, TFIIE, TFIIF and TFIIH were purified
cell_lines: transfected into 2 ml (density: 0.5 million cells/ml) of adherent Sf9 cells
Large-scale protein expression was carried out using 3 × 400 ml of High5 cells
scope: To prepare a sample for performing cross-linking mass-spectrometry, a stable complex of SNAPc-containing Pol-II PIC bound to U5 promoter was isolated.
The peak fractions were then pooled and incubated with 1 mM of bissulfosuccinimidyl suberate (BS3)
Cross-linked peptides derived from pSEC were subjected to liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC–MS)

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (XL-MS) was performed on a reconstituted and purified protein complex (SNAPc-containing Pol II PIC) consisting of proteins from both human and Sus scrofa. While Sf9 and High5 cells were used for recombinant protein expression, the material analyzed by MS was the purified complex.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry component of this study is a cross-linking MS (XL-MS) experiment used for structural validation of a single reconstituted complex (SNAPc-containing Pol II PIC bound to U5 promoter). There is no differential proteomics comparison, perturbation, or treatment axis applied to the MS-analyzed samples; therefore, it is classified as un-classified.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is a structural proteomics study using CXMS to validate cryo-EM models. It is not a differential abundance study, but rather a site-mapping exercise for protein-protein interactions.
